payload.text: Holding the brew-leg proof of the gtools liberator (issue 0057, closed at its as-built) until Gtools is cut and its private tap exists, and hv has enabled gtools on a sleeve. Then molt install gtools must tap over ssh and install, and molt doctor must report Homebrew's gtools as what PATH runs; on kovacs too, through kovacs-sysadm, if Gtools ships a Linux formula. Released when that proof is in.
